name: trie-ide
description: Local-first coding agent: run agent loops on GGUF models via the Trie IDE daemon or any OpenAI-compatible server, with optional hybrid frontier-model guidance.

commands.title: Trie IDE: Connect & Load Local Model

enumDescriptions: Trie IDE daemon (localforged) serving local GGUF models over localhost.
Any OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server (llama-server, LM Studio, Ollama, or a cloud API).
trie-ide.backend.description: Which inference backend drives the agent loop.

trie-ide.daemon.url.description: Base URL of the Trie IDE daemon (localforged).

trie-ide.daemon.storePath.description: Model store volume path on the daemon host (empty = daemon's home directory).

trie-ide.daemon.contextLength.description: Context length to load local models with.

trie-ide.api.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server (llama-server, LM Studio, Ollama, or a cloud endpoint).

trie-ide.api.modelName.description: Model name sent to the OpenAI-compatible server.

trie-ide.api.apiKey.description: Optional Bearer token for the OpenAI-compatible server.

trie-ide.agent.maxToolCalls.description: Maximum tool calls per agent turn before the loop stops.

trie-ide.agent.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the agent model.

trie-ide.frontierAssist.enabled.description: Hybrid mode: consult a frontier (cloud) model for advisory guide notes at checkpoints. The frontier model never drives the tool loop and never edits files.

trie-ide.frontierAssist.apiKey.description: API key for the frontier assist provider.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
